tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google's Gemini enterprise agent is launching to work across your apps and devices. Confirmed by The Verge, the one-stop agent handles your work tasks.
USA Today is suing OpenAI for copyright infringement over artificial intelligence training. Reported by Reuters.
NVIDIA commits 1 billion dollars over five years to U.S. super intelligence research in quantum computing, healthcare and energy. Reported by NVIDIA Newsroom.
Zach Yadegari, age 19, launched privacy-focused artificial intelligence wearable Persona and raised 10 dollars funding. Confirmed by TechCrunch.
Ignite Copilot raises 500k euros to expand to Latin America and reach 5k paying users by 2025. Reported by The New Barcelona Post.
Free every hour.
